phrases.fr: J'ai fait les courses ce matin.
phrases.en: I did the shopping this morning.
phrases.drill: I ___ the shopping this morning. (faire, past)
phrases.focus: passe compose: faire becomes fait, never the infinitive
passe compose: -er verbs drop -er and add -e (visite)

phrases.fr: Je l'ai aide avec le jardin.
phrases.en: I helped him with the garden.
phrases.drill: I ___ him with the garden. (aider, past)
phrases.focus: passe compose with object: je l'ai aide (I him-helped)

phrases.fr: Demain, je dois ecrire le code.
phrases.en: Tomorrow, I must write the code.
phrases.focus: after je dois, the verb stays infinitive: ecrire, not ecrit

phrases.fr: Je vais peindre un koi ce matin.
phrases.en: I'm going to paint a koi this morning.
phrases.focus: je vais + infinitive for the near future: je vais peindre

phrases.fr: J'ai mange un morceau de gateau.
phrases.en: I ate a piece of cake.
phrases.focus: de alone after a quantity: un morceau DE gateau, no article

phrases.fr: J'ai bu un verre de vin hier soir.
phrases.en: I drank a glass of wine last night.
phrases.focus: un verre DE vin, same rule: quantity then plain de

phrases.fr: D'abord, je vais boire un cafe.
phrases.en: First, I'm going to drink a coffee.
phrases.drill: First, I'm going to ___ a coffee. (boire)
phrases.focus: D'abord = first of all (more natural than premiere)

phrases.en: I have a lot of work today.
phrases.drill: I have a lot ___ work today. (of)
phrases.focus: beaucoup DE travail: beaucoup is a quantity too
